title: NPM Package Query
description: Structured intent and package names for npm package details, comparisons, alternatives, and use-case discovery.

supportedIntents.description: Show a package's latest published version, release date, downloads, deprecation status, license, and compatibility metadata.
Compare two or three npm packages using current registry metadata and download activity.
Find related npm packages using package keywords and npm search results.
Search npm for packages suited to a stated JavaScript use case when no package name is supplied.
example: best npm package for date formatting

type.description: The user intent for the npm package request.

filters.description: Package names or a use case extracted from the query.

packages.description: One to three npm package names, including scoped names.

package.description: A single npm package name for details or alternatives.

useCase.description: The task to solve when the query does not name a package.

features.description: Requested package facts such as version, downloads, release date, license, TypeScript, ESM, Node.js, or size.

entities.description: Optional package entity collection for explicit package-name queries.
